tools.name: parse_bank_statement_text
tools.description: Deterministically parse plain bank statement text into normalized transactions with exact integer-cent balance reconciliation (Opening + Credits - Debits = Closing), automatic inverted-sign resolution, and formula-safe CSV, QuickBooks QBO, or OFX export.

tools.name: reconcile_and_export_transactions
tools.description: Normalize structured bank transactions across US/EU amount and date formats into exact integer cents, verify opening/closing and running balance math with row-level discrepancy flags, and export to CSV, QuickBooks QBO, or OFX.
